description.value: Poké Bar is a fast-casual Hawaiian-style poke bowl chain with roots in Japanese sushi dating back to 1989, offering fully customizable bowls built from fresh-daily fish, multiple bases (rice, noodles, or greens), and a wide array of toppings and sauces. The East Broadway Vancouver location is part of a BC-wide franchise network and caters to health-conscious diners looking for a quick, nutritious meal. Online ordering, in-store pickup, and multiple third-party delivery services are available.
